IDT_PROGRESS_FILE_NAME.classAdaptation: Static SS_LEFTNOWORDWRAP becomes a wrapping plain-text label. Show the current filename (directory during scanning); retain the full raw path in tooltip/accessibility and source middle truncation.

IDC_PROGRESS1.classAdaptation: Native progress control becomes QProgressBar with source integer converter/range/cache.
IDC_PROGRESS1.textAdaptation: Bar text hidden; separate percentage above it. Unknown totals use indeterminate progress; final results hide the bar.

IDL_PROGRESS_MESSAGES.classAdaptation: CListView Qt service in the shared diagnostics disclosure. The ordinal column is hidden; raw message order and copy selection/all remain intact.
IDL_PROGRESS_MESSAGES.textAdaptation: Resource List1 is a control identifier; message text comes from CProgressSync.

evidence.requirement: Retain native transport errors for review; hide running progress and Pause.
Keep source worker diagnostics and default Close until acknowledged; the agreed design collapses diagnostics initially.
Agreed simplified presentation keeps current file above progress and footer outside scrolling.
Preserve source diagnostics and order in an independently expandable section.
Retain source pause/continue transition while the native transport supports it.
Agreed result presentation retains failure, cancellation and skipped-item outcomes without a filled progress bar.

behavioralTests.progress: Unknown/known phase transitions, Unicode current file, count or byte progress, 64-bit ranges and backward reset; no invented byte totals.
behavioralTests.pause: Supported native pause freezes rendering and restores prior state after refusing Stop; unsupported callback Pause is hidden.
behavioralTests.stop: Continue/Stop with safe default and Escape; repeated Stop disabled while awaiting actual completion. Completion retires an obsolete Stop question without user input.
behavioralTests.result: Native HRESULT and partial facts select retained failure/cancel/skipped results; full success closes automatically. Worker join, source exception composition and default Close remain covered.
behavioralTests.messages: Source message splitting, ordering, append and selection/all clipboard; ordinal column omitted from the UI.
behavioralTests.scope: Reviewed Qt adaptations to the pinned source component. This contract does not prove independent task lifetime, rendered Windows parity or whole-catalog acceptance.
